title: Xiaomi Mi 11X + EliteGaming MIUI 13 Gaming ROM Build Notes
blurb: EliteGaming MIUI 13 on the Xiaomi Mi 11X — what this gaming-tuned MIUI 13 build changes, and the TWRP you want before you flash it.
video_description:
EliteGaming MIUI 13 on the Xiaomi Mi 11X — what this gaming-tuned MIUI 13 build changes, and the TWRP you want before you flash it.

EliteGaming MIUI 13 sits on a MIUI 13 base, and the tweaks here are aimed at people who game on their phone: less heat, a tidier launcher, and a few resource-hungry bits cut out. If stock MIUI 13 on the Mi 11X runs warm during long sessions, this is the kind of build worth a try. Flash it clean, though — a MIUI build laid over an old data partition is the classic bootloop.

🧩 What's In The Build
• Base updated to MIUI 13
• Dual status bar removed for a cleaner top edge
• Launcher recent views in different styles
• Launcher blur options you can pick from
• Folder blur added
• Blur option in the recents menu
• Column count option in the Launcher, added on user requests
• Heating reduced — and you're free to run your favourite kernel
• A few resource-hungry little features stripped out
• 2G / 3G / 4G selection options removed, they misbehave on newer builds
• New logos and wallpapers

📝 Before You Flash
1. Copy the ROM zip and the TWRP image somewhere safe — internal storage gets wiped.
2. Back up everything you care about.
3. Boot TWRP, format data, then flash the build.
4. Reboot and give the first boot its time.

⚠️ Where People Get Stuck
• Skipping the data format, landing in a bootloop, then blaming the ROM.
• Expecting the removed network options to come back — they're gone by design.
• Flashing with the battery nearly empty.
